text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right, warm-up's done!
Now then, Pandora-san. Shall we head over
for uphill sprints?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm, hey, hey, Kuu-chan-senpai.
Let's skip the uphill sprints and do a
pace run instead♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Why?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just not in the mood for slopes.
Running when you're not feeling it kinda
sucks, right?
I wanna have fun running with you,
Senpai~♡ Right~?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh...! B-But still...!
Didn't you have a mock race coming up
soon, Pandora-san? That's—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's totally fine, 'cause I'm gonna
win!
Leave it to me, I'm a genius after all~~♪
Easy peasy♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm gonna go run a lap first~♪
Ku-chan senpai, keep time for me, 'kay?♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pandora-san!? She's gone...
I-Is she gonna be okay!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Laaaalaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, hey! You're going to check out
the mock race post positions, right!?
Boo's coming too! Let's go together!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, did you chase after me all the way
from the classroom?
Fufu, thank you kindly. Well then, shall
we head off?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Found it! I'm Bracket 5, Gate 10.
Mmm... Gotta think carefully about my
positioning.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Orfe-san is running.
It's a truly star-studded lineup of
runners, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right! Lucky you~!
I wanna race against Orfe-senpai too,
y'know! Right, Lala?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye, that's true. ...Though unfortunately,
to Orfe-san,
I'm still just one of the many commoners.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Stepping up like this would just be an
eyesore.
Now is still... not the time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So that one day Orfe-san might invite
me...
I've still got a lot of polishing to do on
my running.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"We're heeeere! ...Oh? Ooooh!
Rara! Look, the woodchips are all fresh!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, you're right. It's so fluffy.
It's nice and gentle on the legs, what a
blessing.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hooooy, maintenance staff!
The feel of the new woodchips is amazing!
I can't wait to run!

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's great to hear!
Nothing makes me happier than knowing you
can train to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone at the academy... is always
looking out for the Umamusume.
The maintenance crew, security, kitchen
staff, instructors, and Trainers alike."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So that we can run fast. So that we can
make our dreams come true.
You support us closer than anyone else,
don't you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Humans like that... are just what I
loooove so much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um... Whoa, amazing...?! Your pace run
time was spot on...!
As expected of Pandora-san, you're
especially incredible when you're in the
groove...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~!? See, I'm a total genius, aren't
I~♪
Ehehe~ Senpai, praise me mo~re♡ Praise me♡

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pandora! Looking in top form!
We can't afford to lose either. Right,
Lala... Hm? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
――It's about time for our scheduled tandem
gallop.
Didn't see you around, so I was
wonderin'......――Ah, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――One point.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haah!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
――Yes, 10 more minutes of break is fine.
Lala, we'll start our tandem gallop as
scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai, you started training pretty early
today.
Did you check your gate number for the
mock race?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
We're in the same class, right? Looking
forward to working with you—Lala.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine.
...First things first, our training match
together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Sparks are totally flying?

text_block_list.name: Ai & Lala
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, I've won the positioning battle.
Now, I just keep this up until the final
corner—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—First, right here!
This is the critical point, I won't let
you pass!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wha... What the hellllll is that?! You're
making your move here?!
You really show no mercy! You won't even
slack off a bit during training
together?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Aaargh, that back pisses me off so much!
She never, ever lets me pass!
She hates losing with a passion and
refuses to give an inch. That's just who
she is!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That's exactly why—out of everyone,
you're the one!
No matter what! I want to beat the most,
dammit allllll!!)

text_block_list.name: Ai & Lala
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Haah, ya beat me again.
...Still, that was a really meaningful
match race. Thanks a lot, Ai-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was just as outmaneuvered as you were.
Taking advantage of that tiny slow start
to cleanly steal the position.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the opening went
completely off track...!
By the mock race, I swear I'll break out
before you do!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—I will never lose. I won't lose to
anyone.
Not even to an Umamusume called a legend.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And then... I will forge a legend.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――Don't you think?
